mapper.sql: id, upload_id, file_name, file_size, chunk_size, total_chunks, file_hash, hash_mode, status, storage_path, uploaded_bytes, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: insert into upload_task (upload_id, file_name, file_size, chunk_size, total_chunks, file_hash, hash_mode, status, storage_path, uploaded_bytes) values (#{uploadId}, #{fileName}, #{fileSize}, #{chunkSize}, #{totalChunks}, #{fileHash}, #{hashMode}, #{status}, #{storagePath}, #{uploadedBytes})
mapper.select:
select
from upload_task where status = 0 and update_time < date_sub(now(), interval #{hours} hour) order by id asc limit #{limit}
